subject: docs(inf-gold-dispatch-release-alarm): label the detector as an EXPLICIT GAP, not a control (CTO~B ruling on an Andrew-sovereign constraint). So the SNS topic stays deliberately UNSUBSCRIBED and alert wiring is NOT to be re-raised until the underlying process is DONE and PROVEN. The real fix was never a notification: it is the IAM deny (PREVENTION OVER DETECTION), still OPEN, precondition = prove the legitimate Terraform lift still lands BEFORE the deny goes on.
